source: Assessment Task 3, section C.3 (Required Alarm Rules)
note: Create these in Device Profile -> Alarm Rules (preferred). The durations marked UNDEFINED are not specified in the assignment documents; agree a value with your group before configuring.

alarms.name: High Turbidity
alarms.hysteresis: Create at 50 NTU, clear only below 40 NTU.

alarms.name: Gross Contamination
alarms.hysteresis: Create at 200 NTU, clear only below 150 NTU.

alarms.name: pH Out of Range
alarms.hysteresis: Clear band is narrower than create band.

alarms.name: High TDS
alarms.hysteresis: Create at 500 ppm, clear only below 450 ppm.

alarms.name: Supply Interruption
alarms.hysteresis: UNDEFINED: assignment says 'sustained' but gives no duration.

alarms.name: Node Inactive
alarms.hysteresis: UNDEFINED: assignment requires an inactivity timeout but gives no value.
